decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a diverse range of aggressive creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The key strategy involves efficiently playing high-powered creatures like Nishoba Brawler and Scion of Draco, supported by cards like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt for direct damage. The use of Leyline cards and Stubborn Denial offers protection and disruption, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides additional card advantage. By consistently applying pressure through a mix of creatures and spells, this deck aims to win the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells in order to quickly deal damage and secure a victory. Utilizing cards that can pump up creatures like Mutagenic Growth and Slickshot Show-Off, as well as burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to maintain a fast-paced tempo while dealing damage efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for extra mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring to add additional mana to support a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Nishoba Brawler, and Scion of Draco, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial. With a diverse mana base including fetch lands and Leylines, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of early threats and burn spells, while leveraging the companion for additional ramp and flexibility.

This deck focuses on utilizing a diverse array of colors to deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent. By taking advantage of Tribal Flames alongside powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient removal. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding helps to control the board and protect key creatures, while the versatile mana base allows for consistent access to the necessary colors for optimal play.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful control spells and versatile creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence. The key strategy involves using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and gain control of the game. With a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, this deck aims to control the battlefield and outvalue the opponent in order to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Abundant Harvest helps to ensure card advantage and consistency in draws. Additionally, the use of Mutagenic Growth allows for unexpected combat tricks, while Underworld Breach provides additional resource recursion. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize, utilizing the Gruul colors for a fast and powerful aggro strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Abundant Harvest for card selection and consistency. The inclusion of Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear enables quick creature deployment and increased threat potential. The deck seeks to control the board and deal damage efficiently, with the potential to close out games quickly through a combination of creature attacks and direct damage spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board, while cards like Not Dead After All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide card advantage and additional threats. By combining disruption, aggression, and resilience, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Grief, Ragavan, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's hand and board. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats efficiently. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands like Bloodstained Mire and Marsh Flats to ensure consistent mana sources. Additionally, cards like Fabled of the Mirror-Breaker and not Dead After All provide additional value and allow the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on using a diverse range of lands and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. It utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional resources and consistency. Lightning Bolt provides direct damage, while Stubborn Denial keeps key spells safe. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact support the creature strategy, while Tribal Flames and Scion of Draco deliver powerful attacks. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Wild Nacatl are the key creatures that work together to put pressure on the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and ramp into Primeval Titan quickly. The main strategy is to assemble the combo of Amulet of Vigor, multiple bounce lands, and Primeval Titan to repeatedly search for specific lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and bounce lands to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like The One Ring and Tolaria West to provide additional support and options. Overall, the key concept is to efficiently ramp into powerful land combo synergies to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck's strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures while stripping away key cards from their hand with Thoughseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, utilizing synergies between cards like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Angrath's Rampage and Kolaghan's Command adds flexibility and disruption to the deck's game plan. The overall strategy is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately allowing the deck to dominate the battlefield and secure a victory.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent early in the game using cheap spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total before they can stabilize. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for extra reach and recursion of key spells, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and potential late-game value. The deck's focus on speed and efficient threats makes it a formidable aggro deck in the Modern format.

This deck revolves around quickly dealing damage to the opponent, while efficiently removing any threats they may have on the board. With a focus on aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, combined with direct damage spells like Lava Spike and Rift Bolt, the goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also includes powerful burn spells like Boros Charm and Lightning Bolt to maintain pressure and finish off the opponent.
